memorySettings.howItWorks: After each subtask the app saves what the coder learned (gotchas, patterns, what didn't work). Before the architect, planner, coder and QA start, the memories most relevant to their task go into their prompt, and they can search and add memories themselves. Memory is local, per project, in ~/.vibe-teamlead/memories.
memorySettings.whereToSee: See what's stored in Context → Memories. The embedding model finds memories by meaning; without one they are still saved and found by keywords.
